tagline: Nine bays, most reachable only by boat — the real transit node of the Oaxaca coast.
summary: Bahías de Huatulco is a FONATUR-planned resort spanning nine bays and dozens of beaches, most of which are reachable only by boat. A water-taxi network runs from Santa Cruz Marina out to the bays (Maguey, El Órgano, Cacaluta and more), and a larger pier is under construction. This is the genuine scheduled-transit node of the Oaxaca coast and a strong full/display market with a clear signature service.

competitive_landscape: A water-taxi cooperative serves the bays from Santa Cruz Marina; no premium tier exists. The pain is capacity and comfort at peak.
seasonality: Pacific hurricane season (Jun–Nov); winter is peak. The bays are protected coves.
regulatory_note: Mexican jurisdiction: API/FONATUR, Capitanía de Puerto (SEMAR); the bays include protected national-park waters.
